title: Anti-fatigue mechanism of Jiu Zhi Huang Qi: An integrated approach combining UHPLC-QE-MS, bioinformatics analyses, and experimental validation.
authors: Miao, Yixiang; Chang, Yuan; Dong, Kexu; Zhang, Yuan; Shi, Ji; Liu, Pengpeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方抗疲劳机制，涉及分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Fatigue has emerged as a significant global health concern. Based on World Health Organization statistics, approximately 488 million people worldwide face risks associated with excessive fatigue. Excessive fatigue is recognized as a major risk factor for stroke and ischemic heart disease. In China, approximately 600,000 deaths are annually attributed to excessive fatigue. Ancient texts document the anti-fatigue properties of Jiu Zhi Huang Qi (JZHQ), although the precise underlying mechanisms remain unclear. This study aimed to validate the anti-fatigue efficacy of JZHQ and elucidate the underlying mechanisms of action, illuminating a novel therapeutic strategy against fatigue. Utilizing UHPLC-QE-MS and bioinformatics analysis, we identified 25 putative anti-fatigue target genes and 44 bioactive components of JZHQ. Enrichment analysis revealed that JZHQ exerts anti-fatigue effects by modulating energy metabolism, regulating protein phosphorylation, and affecting antioxidant pathways. In vivo experiments and subsequent ELISA and histopathological analysis indicated that JZHQ enhances antioxidant capacity and mitigates tissue damage. RT-PCR and Western blotting also confirmed that JZHQ activates the AMPK/PGC-1alpha signaling pathway, promotes AMPK phosphorylation and enhances energy metabolism. Molecular docking indicated favorable binding affinity between key JZHQ components and targets within the AMPK/PGC-1alpha pathway. Overall, JZHQ was shown to upregulate antioxidant enzymes and glycogen, eliminate harmful metabolites, such as malondialdehyde, activate the AMPK/PGC-1alpha pathway, enhance AMPK phosphorylation, and upregulate the expression of PGC-1alpha, thereby enhancing energy metabolism and protecting against fatigue.
abstract_zh: 疲劳已成为一个重大的全球健康问题。根据世界卫生组织的统计数据，全球约有4.88亿人面临与过度疲劳相关的风险。过度疲劳被认为是中风和缺血性心脏病的主要风险因素。在中国，每年约有60万人死于过度疲劳。古代文献记载了九制黄芪（JZHQ）的抗疲劳特性，但其确切的作用机制尚不清楚。本研究旨在验证JZHQ的抗疲劳功效，并阐明其潜在的作用机制，为对抗疲劳提供一种新的治疗策略。利用UHPLC-QE-MS和生物信息学分析，我们鉴定了25个推测的抗疲劳靶基因和44种JZHQ的生物活性成分。富集分析显示，JZHQ通过调节能量代谢、调控蛋白质磷酸化以及影响抗氧化途径来发挥抗疲劳作用。体内实验及随后的ELISA和组织病理学分析表明，JZHQ增强了抗氧化能力并减轻了组织损伤。RT-PCR和Western blotting也证实，JZHQ激活了AMPK/PGC-1alpha信号通路，促进了AMPK磷酸化并增强了能量代谢。分子对接显示，JZHQ的关键成分与AMPK/PGC-1alpha通路中的靶点之间具有良好的结合亲和力。总体而言，JZHQ被证明能够上调抗氧化酶和糖原，清除有害代谢产物如丙二醛，激活AMPK/PGC-1alpha通路，增强AMPK磷酸化，并上调PGC-1alpha的表达，从而增强能量代谢并抵御疲劳。
